searches.reason: Explore learned intent changes instead of fixed recency weights: timestamp-conditioned GRU gates could preserve durable interests while reducing stale-state influence. Seek practical single-network designs trained only on observed histories and timestamps, with padding-invariant encoding.

searches.reason: Investigate whether jointly learned title and description features help distinguish specific next-item matches from broad affinity, especially in Electronics. Seek lightweight text encoders trained from scratch within one GRU recommender, without pretrained weights or separately fitted scores; do not assume text establishes compatibility or ownership satisfaction.
searches.query: GRU sequential recommendation jointly trained item text encoder titles descriptions next item prediction complementary products without pretrained embeddings

searches.reason: Challenge whether BPR-max with a modest negative pool provides enough discrimination. Seek scalable sampled-softmax or contrastive objectives with sampling correction and false-negative mitigation, motivated by Electronics’ weak sampled margins. Compare objectives within the corrected GRU backbone and judge gains by the fixed macro validation HR@10.
searches.query: GRU4Rec sequential recommendation sampled softmax contrastive learning hard negatives sampling bias correction false negatives 2024 2025 2026
